note: Small family-run RV park on a private drive in a wooded hollow below the Moundsville Country Club, five minutes from downtown Moundsville in the northern panhandle; owned and operated by Derek and his father Jerry. Oversized 2,030+ sq ft extended-stay sites with grassed yards. County water arrives at a high +/- 120 psi, so a pressure regulator is required. Pet-friendly with breed restrictions. The park markets itself as extended-stay housing near hospitals and the Marcellus/Utica and other construction sites. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages confirm 20/30/50-amp full hookups and basic Wi-Fi; booking rewritten from the reservations page (short stays by request form, approval, then tenant registration).
